scheme_name: Regional Centre for Training and Production of Mushroom
other_conditions: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
The applicant must be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.
The applicant must own or lease land of at least 0.2 hectares.
Benefits are allotted on a first‑come‑first‑serve basis.
benefits_summary: Provides a 50% subsidy on mushroom spawns and compost, and a one‑time financial assistance of ₹22,000 per unit to eligible growers.
